name: Sea Turtle Remains
summary: Along Darkshore, Sea Turtle Remains gather on the coast and beneath the waves. Researchers in Auberdine study the growing number of dead sea turtles.

sections.title: A Disturbing Strand
sections.body: Giant sea creatures wash ashore along Darkshore, while others lie beneath the water near sunken wrecks. In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers bone fragments and tissue from their bodies. The Temple of the Moon in Darnassus urgently asks for these samples. Its scholars and priestesses fear the creatures are fleeing an unnatural disturbance in the waters around Teldrassil.

sections.title: Scavengers of the Shallows
sections.body: Recovering the remains is dangerous. Murloc tribes along the coast gather around the huge carcasses, picking their bones clean and nesting beside them. Scholars need fresh bone fragments and tissue before the scavengers destroy evidence that might explain the creatures' fatal migration.

faq.q: What are these remains used for?
faq.answer: In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde collects remains for the scholars and priestesses at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. They seek to learn why so many ocean creatures are dying along Darkshore.

faq.q: Why are sea turtles beaching themselves in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Researchers have not found the cause, but they fear marine life is fleeing an unsettling presence in the waters around Teldrassil. These strandings point to widespread distress among marine life.

aliases: where to find skeletal sea turtle
faq.answer: Giant sea turtle carcasses lie along Darkshore's coast. Some rest in shallow water near sunken ships west of Auberdine, while others litter beaches surrounded by murloc encampments.
In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde collects the remains and sends detailed reports to the Sisterhood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

angles.text: The mass stranding of sea life off your ancestral coast is an ominous sign. The suspected cause lies in the waters encircling Teldrassil.
The unnatural deaths of great sea creatures point to a deeper corruption disturbing nature's balance along the Kalimdor coast.
